hints: hardened.ps1 is the same audited script from L7.6 -- CmdletBinding, a validated param, try/catch/finally, logging on, and no bare code-execution call. If your L7.6 workspace is still on disk, bring it forward: cp ../L7.6/hardened.ps1 .

pssa-clean.txt is the real Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer output on hardened.ps1, redirected to a file: Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path ./hardened.ps1 | Select-Object RuleName, Severity > pssa-clean.txt -- a genuinely clean script produces a 0-byte file. Also capture pssa-version.txt: Get-Module -ListAvailable PSScriptAnalyzer | Select-Object Name, Version > pssa-version.txt -- this proves PSSA actually ran, since a 0-byte pssa-clean.txt alone can't tell 'clean' from 'never ran'.
